name: Wind for When the Stream Is Low

pages.text: Bram: $(italic)The stream drops in high summer and freezes in winter. The roof does neither.$()$(br2)Speed off a windmill is $(bold)two RPM per sail$(), and it stops climbing at $(bold)16 RPM$().$(br2)$(bold)Eight sails reaches the ceiling.$() A ninth sail does nothing at all. That is why the crate holds exactly eight.
pages.title: The Roof

pages.text: The bearing's stress figure is 512 -- it is not what limits you. Speed is. Read the total off a Stressometer if you want the exact number on the day.

$(li)Wool for the sails: $(bold)16$(), in Bram's crate from Q16.$(li)Sails go on the shaft, then you right-click the bearing once to assemble.$(li)The roof frame is already standing and the slot is marked. Put it in the marked slot; nothing here is a judgement call.$(br2)Q29 pays back 6 gearboxes, a clutch, a gearshift and 3 Mechanical Crafters -- $(bold)2 su per RPM$() each, so 3 crafters is 48 su. Cheap.
